items.source: Note that this class extends BeanPropertyRowMapper and can therefore serve as a common choice for any mapped target class, flexibly adapting to constructor style versus setter methods in the mapped class.
items.translation: 注意，该类扩展了BeanPropertyRowMapper，因此可用作任何映射目标类的通用选择，灵活适应映射类中的构造函数风格与 setter 方法。

items.source: Please note that this class is designed to provide convenience rather than high performance. For best performance, consider using a custom readable mapping Function implementation.
items.translation: 请注意，该类旨在提供便利性而非高性能。若要获得最佳性能，请考虑使用自定义的可读映射 `<code>Function` 实现。

items.source: constructMappedInstance in class BeanPropertyRowMapper<T>
items.translation: `constructMappedInstance` 在类 `BeanPropertyRowMapper<T>` 中

items.source: The term "data class" applies to Java records, Kotlin data classes, and any class which has a constructor with named parameters that are intended to be mapped to corresponding column names.
items.translation: “数据类”（data class）这一术语适用于 Java 的record、Kotlin 的data classes，以及任何具有命名参数构造函数的类，这些参数旨在映射到相应的列名。

items.source:
When combining a data class constructor with setter methods, any property
mapped successfully via a constructor argument will not be mapped additionally
via a corresponding setter method. This means that constructor arguments take
precedence over property setter methods.
items.translation: 当将数据类构造函数与 setter 方法结合使用时，任何通过构造函数参数成功映射的属性，都不会再通过对应的 setter 方法进行额外映射。这意味着构造函数参数的优先级高于属性 setter 方法。

items.source:
The default implementation simply instantiates the mapped class. Can be
overridden in subclasses.
items.translation: 默认实现只是实例化映射类。可以在子类中重写它。

items.source: Construct an instance of the mapped class for the current Readable.
items.translation: 为当前的Readable构建映射类的实例。
